name: refactor_shell_env_blocks_to_loop
description: Three copy-pasted per-environment blocks -> one function/loop, byte-identical output; drift broken swaps replica counts while deduplicating
prompts: scripts/deploy_report.sh appends a three-section report (dev, staging, prod) to the file given as its argument, and the three sections are pure copy-paste - same three echo lines with the environment name, its URL (https://<env>.example.com), and its replica count hardcoded each time. Deduplicate it: one function (or loop over the env/replica data) that emits a section, called once per environment. The output must stay BYTE-identical: same sections in the same promotion order (dev, staging, prod), same lines, same replica counts (dev 1, staging 2, prod 6), still APPENDING to the report file (>>), and still correct when the report path contains spaces. Keep `set -euo pipefail`.

setup_files.scripts/deploy_report.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Render the deploy report: one section per environment, in promotion order.
REPORT=$1

echo "== dev ==" >> "$REPORT"
echo "url=https://dev.example.com" >> "$REPORT"
echo "replicas=1" >> "$REPORT"

echo "== staging ==" >> "$REPORT"
echo "url=https://staging.example.com" >> "$REPORT"
echo "replicas=2" >> "$REPORT"

echo "== prod ==" >> "$REPORT"
echo "url=https://prod.example.com" >> "$REPORT"
echo "replicas=6" >> "$REPORT"

test_setup_files.check_report_script.py:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

base = Path("report_check_tmp")
shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True)
base.mkdir()
report = base / "deploy report.txt"   # space on purpose - quoting must hold

proc = subprocess.run(
    ["bash", "scripts/deploy_report.sh", str(report).replace("\\", "/")],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f"script failed (exit {proc.returncode}): {proc.stderr}"

expected = """== dev ==
url=https://dev.example.com
replicas=1
== staging ==
url=https://staging.example.com
replicas=2
== prod ==
url=https://prod.example.com
replicas=6
"""
got = report.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert got == expected, f"report drifted.\nexpected:\n{expected}\ngot:\n{got}"

# Appending is part of the contract: a second run adds a second copy.
proc = subprocess.run(
    ["bash", "scripts/deploy_report.sh", str(report).replace("\\", "/")],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
)
assert proc.returncode == 0
assert report.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == expected * 2, "output must append, not truncate"

print("PASS deploy report checks")

reference_solution.scripts/deploy_report.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Render the deploy report: one section per environment, in promotion order.
REPORT=$1

emit_env() {
  local env=$1 replicas=$2
  echo "== $env ==" >> "$REPORT"
  echo "url=https://$env.example.com" >> "$REPORT"
  echo "replicas=$replicas" >> "$REPORT"
}

emit_env dev 1
emit_env staging 2
emit_env prod 6
